workflows..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: dream-net CI

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
  push:
    # Keep branch pushes restricted to main. Non-tag pushes publish to the shared
    # "development" release, so feature branches would compete for the same release.
    branches: main
    tags: ['*']

jobs:
  build:
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    uses: DreamWeave-MP/StroggForge/.github/workflows/libGlobalBuild.yml@v43
    secrets: inherit
    with:
      crate_names: '["dream-net"]'
      # rust-version from Cargo.toml (1.88: let chains)
      msrv: auto
      # Criterion benches: wire codec, per-call costs, lossy links, 256-peer scale, and
      # real loopback netcode against a one-datagram-per-event baseline
      generate_benchmarks: true
